name: Task
about: Track implementation, refactoring, or documentation work
title: "[Task] "
labels: [task]
assignees: []
---

## Scope

Describe the work to be done.

## Metadata

- Priority:
- Milestone:
- Area:
- Platform:
- Related issue(s):
- Suggested labels:

## Definition of done

- [ ] Implementation is complete or documentation is updated
- [ ] Relevant checks have passed
- [ ] No unrelated files were changed
- [ ] The change is ready for review with clear commit boundaries

## Branch and commit notes

- Branch name should follow the ApolloDroid convention: `type/issue-number-short-description`
- Commit messages should follow: `type(scope): subject`

## Review notes

- What should reviewers inspect first?
- What is the riskiest part of the change?
